arguments.message: You can subscribe directly from our status page. On the page, click the **Subscribe** button and choose the delivery method you prefer – email, SMS, or a webhook. If you only want alerts for specific parts of the platform, you can scope the subscription to those components so you only receive updates for incidents that affect your team. Once subscribed, you’ll get a notification the moment an incident is opened, updated, or resolved, before it reaches customers through other channels.
